warmup_policy: fixed identical priming per variant; load and capture excluded only from steady-state metric and reported separately
semantics: Each schedule row has pair_id, case_id, repetition_id, order (AB or BA), seed, P/N and cache contract; empty/unhashed schedule must be BLOCKED. A/B each retain their own capability key; completed comparison contract fixes shared factors and preregistered differences. Unfilled keys/contract are BLOCKED.
